svg.aria-label: Left: steps per episode on the Dyna maze, averaged over 30 runs, on a log scale, for Dyna-Q with 0, 5 and 50 planning steps per real step; the average first falls to 20 steps or fewer in episode 3 with 50 planning steps, episode 6 with 5, and episode 30 without planning. Middle: cumulative reward on the shortcut maze, averaged over 10 runs; after the shortcut opens at step 3,000 Dyna-Q+ finds it and its reward rate rises, while Dyna-Q keeps using the old path. Right: the fraction of 300 tic-tac-toe positions in which UCT's chosen move keeps the minimax value, against the number of simulations, rising from 80 percent at 10 simulations to 100 percent at 3,000
